## Bio

I am an undergraduate student in Genomic Sciences at the National Autonomous University of Mexico (UNAM), campus Cuernavaca. My academic interests focus on genomics, evolution, bioinformatics, and molecular biology.

Throughout my training, I have completed coursework in R, Python, and Bash, applying these tools to the analysis of genomic data, differential expression studies, functional enrichment, and computational biology projects. My experience includes developing computational workflows for biological data interpretation and working with large-scale genomic datasets.

My interests also extend to evolutionary biology, paleogenomics, regenerative medicine, and the biotechnological production of bioactive metabolites from plants and microorganisms. I am particularly motivated by the intersection of biology and computation, aiming to integrate artificial intelligence and molecular biology to better understand complex biological processes and their applications in biotechnology and medicine.
